title: [basis] vostochnoe / first_pear_nursery — ultrasonic_weather_station_01
description: Метеостанция: круговой компас со сторонами света и стрелкой по углу датчика. При 0° стрелка направлена на север, включая штиль.

panels.title: НАПРАВЛЕНИЕ
panels.description: Север сверху, восток справа. Стрелка показывает угол датчика, в том числе 0° на север при штиле. В центре — скорость ветра.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (metric) metric, value FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric IN ('wind_speed_ms','wind_direction_deg') ORDER BY metric, created_at DESC) SELECT max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='wind_speed_ms')::double precision AS wind_speed_ms, max(value) FILTER (WHERE metric='wind_direction_deg')::double precision AS wind_direction_deg FROM latest

panels.title: ВЕТЕР
panels.description: Показания ниже 0,1 м/с отображаются как штиль.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, value AS "Скорость ветра" FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric='wind_speed_ms' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT created_at AS time, value AS "Температура" FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric='air_temperature_c' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT created_at AS time, value AS "Влажность" FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric='relative_humidity_pct' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT created_at AS time, value AS "Давление" FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric='air_pressure_kpa' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT created_at AS time, value AS "Освещённость" FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric='illuminance_lux' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT created_at AS time, metric, value FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric IN ('wind_speed_ms','air_temperature_c','relative_humidity_pct','air_pressure_kpa','illuminance_lux','rainfall_mm') AND $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY created_at

SELECT now() AS time, COALESCE((SELECT value FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric='rainfall_mm' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1), 0)::double precision AS "Осадки"

SELECT created_at AS time, value AS "Сила ветра" FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric='wind_force' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT now() AS time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - max(created_at)))::double precision AS "Возраст пакета" FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01'

panels.title: НАПРАВЛЕНИЕ
panels.description: Угол в градусах; компас справа показывает стороны света.

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS time, value AS "Направление" FROM public.unit_node_metrics WHERE tenant='basis' AND region='vostochnoe' AND fleet='first_pear_nursery' AND unit_id='ultrasonic_weather_station_01' AND metric='wind_direction_deg' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
